extra.stata_bridge_status: audited Mata algorithm bridge, materialized 2026-08-06 with licensed Stata 18
extra.algorithm: exhaustive depth-1 search over every (covariate, distinct observed threshold) pair and both leaf orientations, plus the two constant policies; objective V = mean(gamma * pi)
extra.split_convention: x <= t goes left; ties are kept on the same side by only evaluating thresholds at the last index of each run of equal values
extra.depth2_not_bridged: the four depth-2 statistics are not emitted: the exact depth-2 optimum needs policytree's incremental search, and a heuristic that happens to agree on this fixture would be worse evidence than an honest two-sided row
